# reversing-mcp

> FastMCP 3.4+ server for static binary analysis, reverse engineering, and Directmedia format tools. Ghidra headless integration.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): Main readme
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Release history
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent context
- [Install](INSTALL.md): Installation guide
- [Ghidra Plugin](GHIDRA_PLUGIN_SETUP.md): Ghidra setup
- [Ghidra Extensions](docs/GHIDRA_EXTENSIONS.md): Community extension download + CRUD (SNES/65816-first catalog)
- [Full Documentation](llms-full.txt): Complete LLM context and tool reference
- [PRD](PRD.md): Vision - agent-driven feature-to-code-map platform

## Tools (27)
- [Server](src/reversing_mcp/server.py): FastMCP server with all tools
- [Analyzers](src/reversing_mcp/analyzers.py): Binary analysis, PE parsing, entropy, string
- [Ghidra extensions](src/reversing_mcp/ghidra_extensions.py): Community extension catalog + download/CRUD
- [REA bridge](src/reversing_mcp/rea_bridge.py): REA sidecar subprocess bridge
- [Directmedia DKI](src/reversing_mcp/directmedia_dki.py): DKI decoder
- [DigiBib Research](src/reversing_mcp/digibib_research.py): DigiBib snapshot builder
- [Transport](src/reversing_mcp/transport.py): stdio/HTTP/SSE dual transport

## Tools Listing
| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `analyze_binary` | Full binary analysis: file type, strings, entropy, functions |
| `extract_strings` | Extract ASCII/Unicode strings from file |
| `get_hexdump` | Hex dump of file bytes at offset |
| `analyze_entropy` | Shannon entropy analysis per block |
| `find_functions` | Find functions using Ghidra/radare2 |
| `get_file_info` | File metadata via `file` command |
| `check_tools` | Check installed reversing tools (incl. REA sidecar) |
| `rea_investigate` | REA sidecar delegate: JS/Electron/native via provider |
| `digibib_research_snapshot` | DigiBib research snapshot |
| `analyze_pe_file` | PE file structure analysis |
| `decode_dki_file` | Decode DKI file format |
| `analyze_directmedia_file` | Directmedia format analysis |
| `decompress_directmedia_library` | Decompress DM library archives |
| `reva` | Manage ReVa lifecycle (status, start headless/GUI, stop) |
| `ghidra` | ReVa-backed Ghidra ops: status/start/stop/tools/describe/call |
| `ghidra_extensions` | Community extension download + CRUD (catalog/list/install/remove/enable/disable). See docs/GHIDRA_EXTENSIONS.md |
| `toolbox` | Toolchain inventory probe, package installation, and policies |
| `shutdown` | Graceful server shutdown |
| `show_tools_card` | Engine inventory as in-chat Prefab card |
| `gym` | Cloning-run lifecycle (start/status/advance/stop/list) |
| `engine` | DiE / capa / Frida: compiler+packer ID, capabilities, runtime hooks |
| `help` | Multi-level help system |
| `hercules_hw_info` / `hercules_virtual_spin` / `hercules_virtual_fader` / `hercules_virtual_button` / `hercules_decode_packet` | Hercules DJ Console MK1 virtualizer: descriptors, HID/MIDI synthesis, packet decode |

- [Pyproject](pyproject.toml): Python project config
- [Glama](glama.json): AI registry metadata
